gīveyyaka.cp: neut. an ornament for the neck.
gīveyyaka.p: [Gīveyya+ka] (na) CL=8 (1)Necklace made of bright gem, necklace, necklace of pearls, shells, amber or any beads. (2) layer which is sewing at the neck rubbing. Kusi - see also.
a: (၁)လည်ရွဲတန်ဆာ၊ လည်ဆွဲ တန်ဆာ၊ ပုတီး။(၂)လည်ပင်းဖြင့် ပွတ်တိုက်ထိမိရာအရပ်၌ ချုပ်စပ်အပ်သောအလွှာ။ ကုသိ-လည်းကြည့်။

B:
gīveyyaka：gīveyyaka（na）
ဂီဝေယျက（န）
[gīveyya+ka]
[ဂီဝေယျ+က]
C: gīveyyaka：[nt.] an ornament for the neck.
P: Gīveyyaka，（nt.） [cp．Sk．graiveyaka] necklace，an ornament for the neck （orig．“something belonging to the neck，” cp．necklet，bracelet，etc.） Vin.I，287； A.I，254 sq．（=Vism.247，where gīveyya only）； 257； III，16； J.IV，395 （gīveyya only）； V，297； VI，590； VvA.104．（Page 252）
U: GĪVEYYAKA：[nt] vật trang điểm nơi cổ
Q: gīveyyaka：trong lá y vai trái của tỳ khưu có một chỗ khi đắp y luôn nằm sau cổ，từ này dùng gọi điểm ấy
K:
gīveyyaka：ဂီဝေယျက （န）
[ဂီဝေယျ+က]
（၁） လည်ရွဲတန်ဆာ၊ လည်ဆွဲ တန်ဆာ၊ ပုတီး။ （၂） လည်ပင်းဖြင့် ပွတ်တိုက်ထိမိရာအရပ်၌ ချုပ်စပ်အပ်သောအလွှာ။ ကုသိ-လည်းကြည့်။
R:
gīveyyaka：ဂီဝေယျက （န）
လည်ကပ်တန်ဆာ။ လည်ရွဲတန်ဆာ။
DOP: gīveyyaka n. ( and ~ā, f. ?) [ S. graiveyaka], 1. a necklace ; M III 243, 21 (yassā yassā ca pilandhanavikatiyā ākaṅkhati … yadi kuṇḍalāya yadi ~āya yadi suvaṇṇa-mālāya) = A I 254, 9 (~e; Mp II 362, 11 : ~e ti gīvālaṅkāre) ≠ 257, 28 (~e) quoted Vism 247, 31 ( Ce, Se ~āya; Be, Ee gīveyyāya) ≠ A III 16, 17 ( Be, Ce ~āya; Ee, Se ~ena); Ja V 297, 14 (~aṃ dassāmī ti); — 2. the neckpiece (of a bhikkhu’s robe); neck-binding ; Vin I 287, 25 (~aṃ pi nāma karissati; Sp 1127, 19 : ~an ti gīvaveṭhanaṭṭhāne daḷhīkaraṇatthaṃ aññaṃ suttasaṃsibbitaṃ āgantuka-paṭaṃ).
NCP: neuter | giiveyyaka a necklace. the neck piece of a bhikkhu’s robe; neck-binding.

gīvā.p: [Gā+īva+ā] (thī) CL=8 Dhāna,ṭī.263. Gāyanti etāyati gīvā, galo. Moga,7.2va3.(grīvā-saṃ)]  (1) neck, throat, the throat, neck. (2)  giving food, giving property/finance, compensate, compensation. (Na) (3) necklace.

F: Gīvā，【阴】脖子，颈。gīvaṭṭhika，颈骨。颈：后颈曰「脰tau7」或「领脰nia2tau7」；前颈曰「颔am7」或「颔颈am7kun2」。
B:
gīvā：gīvā（thī）
ဂီဝါ（ထီ）
[gā+īva+ā．，ṭī.263．gāyanti etāyati gīvā，galo．，7.2va3．（grīvā-saṃ）]
[ဂါ+ဤဝ+အာ။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ။၂၆၃။ ဂါယန္တိ ဧတာယတိ ဂီဝါ၊ ဂလော။ မောဂ်၊၇။၂ဝ၃။ （ဂြီဝါ-သံ）]
P: Gīvā，（f.） [Sk．grīvā，to *gǔer to swallow，as signifying throat：see note on gala for etym.] the neck Sn.609； J.I，74 （°ṁ pasāreti to stretch forth），167 （pasārita°），207，222，265； III，52； VvA.27 （mayūra°），157； DA.I，296 （°āya kuṇḍa-daṇḍaka-bandhana，as exhibition & punishment）：similarly in the sense of “life” （hinting at decapitation） J.II，300 （°ṁ karissāmi “I shall go for his neck”）； IV，431=V.23．-- Syn．kaṇṭha the primary meaning of which is neck，whereas gīvā orig．throat．（Page 252）
R:
gīvā：ဂီဝါ （ဣ）
လည်။ လည်ပင်း။ အစားပေးခြင်း။ အစားဆပ်ခြင်း။ ကြွေးမြီ။
ဂီဝါယ ဂဟေတွာ နီဟရထ၊ လည်၌ ကိုင်၍ နှင်ထုတ်ကုန်လော့။ ဂီဝါယ ဂီဝံ အာဟစ္စ၊ လည်ချင်းထိ၍။
DOP: gīva n. [ cf S. graiva], a necklace; a chain worn round the neck of an elephant ; Ja V 297, 16* (nekkhaṃ gīvaṃ te kāressaṃ; 297, 23´ foll. : tava gīveyyaṃ sabbasuvaṇṇa-mayam eva kāressāmī ti attho, nekkhaṃ gīvaṃ te karissāmī ti pi pāṭho, tava gīvāya nekkhamayaṃ piḷandhanaṃ piḷandhessāmī ti attho,? Be so; Ee tava gīvaṃ … gīvāya nekkhassa piḷandhanaṃ bandhessāmī ti; Ce, Se tava gīvaṃ sabbasuvaṇṇam eva; cf 297, 14 : gīveyyakaṃ dassāmī ti); Sadd 922, 23 (~aṃ gevaṃ gīveyyaṃ … vaṇṇabhedo ’yaṃ).

1 gīvā f. [ S. grīvā], the neck (of men and animals); the neck of a jar ; Abh 263 (galo ca kaṇṭho ~ā ca); 1129; Vin I 191, 2 (bhikkhū … nadiyā gāvīnaṃ tarantīnaṃ … ~āya pi gaṇhanti); III 80, 15 (aññataro bhikkhu tassa bhikkhuno ~āyaṃ pahāraṃ adāsi); M III 169, 16 (api nu so kāṇo kacchapo amukasmiṃ ekacchiggale yuge ~aṃ paveseyyā ti); Thī 81 (pakkhipiṃ pāsaṃ ~āyaṃ); Ja I 424, 2 (nidhikumbhiyo ~āya ~aṃ āhacca ṭhitā); II 261, 18* (bahūni narasīsāni … ~āsu paṭimukkāni); V 70, 25* (ehi me piṭṭhim āruyha ~aṃ gaṇhāhi bāhuhi); VI 199, 16* (khippaṃ ~aṃ pasārehi na te dassāmi jīvitaṃ … chedayissāmi te siraṃ); Mil 418, 9 (issattho sare pātayanto … aṅguliyo nirantaraṃ karoti ~aṃ paggaṇhāti …); Vism 124, 23 (uccatare nisinnena ~aṃ onamitvā oloketabbaṃ hoti); Sp 348, 9 (sīsato vā kaṇṇato vā ~ato vā hatthato vā alaṅkāraṃ chinditvā); 849, 8 (sāmaṇero kuṭassa ~aṃ pattassa mukhavaṭṭiyaṃ ṭhapetvā āvajjeti); 1008, 32 (Janapadakalyāṇī … ~aṃ pasāretvā olokesi); Ps V 17, 2 (kathetukāmo ~aṃ paggaṇhāti hanukaṃ cāleti); Mhv 7:20 (yakkhiṃ ādāya ~āya nārācavalayena so); — °’- āyāmakaṃ , ind. , stretching the neck; so as to stretch the neck, to extend the throat ;? Sv 83, 22 (tato pi manāpamanāpaṃ ~aṃ bhuñjati yeva; Sv-pṭ I 162, 25 : ~an ti gīvaṃ āyamitvā āyamitvā yathā ca [ vl vā] bhutte atibhuttatāya gīvā āyamitabbā va hoti) = Nidd-a I 404, 30 ; — see also īsakāyatagīva ( sv īsakaṃ ), oṭṭhagīvi ( sv oṭṭha 1 ), nīlagīva ( sv nīla ).
NCP: feminine | giivaa the neck (of humans and animals); the neck of a jar.
